description: This file defines a 'Cube' class that extends 'GLShape'. It constructs a 3D cube shape with specified vertices for each face, adding faces in a clockwise orientation. The class includes constants representing each face of the cube.

classes.name: Cube
classes.description: Represents a 3D cube shape in a graphics rendering context, with vertices and faces set up for rendering.

methods.name: Cube
methods.description: Constructor that initializes vertices for all six faces of the cube using provided spatial boundaries and creates faces in clockwise order.
